description: This file contains SCSS functions, mixins, and keyframes related to styling helpers, including mathematical functions, transition effects, animations, transform properties, media queries, and clearfix.

methods.name: exponent
methods.description: Calculates the exponentiation of a base to an exponent, supporting positive and negative integers.

methods.name: pow
methods.description: Wrapper function that calls exponent for convenience.

methods.name: transition
methods.description: Applies cross-browser transition properties to elements.

methods.name: animation-fill-mode
methods.description: Sets the fill mode for animations with cross-browser support.

methods.name: smaller
methods.description: Creates a media query mixin for maximum screen width.

methods.name: clearfix
methods.description: Provides a SCSS mixin for clearfix to clear floats.
